event_description: Fires on the server when a new user successfully creates an account.
Fires on the server when an existing user signs in successfully.
Fires on the server when a user signs out of their account.
Fires on the server when a user updates their account name or email.
Fires on the server when a user successfully changes their password.
Fires on the server when a user deletes their account — a critical churn signal.
Fires on the server when a team owner sends an invitation to a new member.
Fires on the server when a team owner removes a member from the team.
Fires on the server when a user initiates a Stripe checkout session.
Fires on the server when Stripe redirects back and the subscription is activated — the primary revenue conversion event.
Fires on the server via Stripe webhook when a subscription status changes.
Fires on the server via Stripe webhook when a subscription is deleted/canceled.
Fires client-side when a visitor copies the setup commands from the landing page terminal.
Fires client-side when a user clicks Manage Subscription to open the Stripe customer portal.
